about: The editor's spawning rows: what the Impaler's strike (ability 333) and the Alpha Commander's call (ability 463) summon, put into their code (enemy_summons.c); a composition group's enemy family (EnemyComposition +0); difficulty 7's Terminid patrol cap past 128 and traveller interval. The logs prove the edits land and the code takes them; what they do needs a look in a Terminid mission (tests/in-game/README.md): an Impaler's strike raises 5 tentacles, an Alpha Commander digs up 2 Hunters a call (6 a summon), and on difficulty 7 more patrols walk at once.
